Real initramfs SSH verified via public host key obtained from USB ACM. SPI device exists; watchdog/log-protected insmod exit0 but probe returns EINVAL for missing firmware config-array-size, before reset/regulator access. No input device.

Candidate3 preparation write did not stop repeated ready events; eight-event IRQ guard stopped flooding. Fresh SSH healthy and load average 0.00.
Candidate4 board10MHz still repeats03; GPIO debug shows CS output high, reset output high, IRQ input high after guard. No touch proof.

Candidate6 without IRQ: postscan00 then03x3 then00x4; IRQ raw becomes inactive high. readSysInfo header unexpectedly00 and first next FIFO has unrelated69... bytes. Transport staging hypothesis needs comparison.

Candidate7 single full-duplex transfer failed reset and chip ID read02/02. Reject helper and restore original split-read transport. Existing fallback attempted volatile SPI4 config, not firmware burn.
Candidate8 at1MHz still has invalid SysInfo dimensions; post-scan ready repeats3 then queue empties, IRQ inactive. No speed fix established.

Candidate9 failed initial reset/chip ID before IRQ change executed. Therefore drain-before-IRQ hypothesis untested; repeated module swaps have a state-dependent initialization problem. Candidate7 failure also cannot be attributed solely to transfer form.

Audit correction: candidate4 removed12MHz assignment but warm spi_device retains prior max_speed_hz; without resetting fromDT or measured clock it does not prove10MHz was used. Candidate8 explicitly caps at1MHz. Do not claim10MHz ruled out.

Candidate10 GPIO reset100ms/settle100ms plus startup FIFO drain bound successfully; IRQ explicitly enabled. Counter203244 remained unchanged over3s, loadavg0.00. SysInfo dimensions still invalid. Physical evdev capture armed; no finger proof yet.

User confirmed three taps and two horizontal swipes during active host evdev capture. Result0bytes/0events/0ABS_XY; IRQ stayed203244. NativeUSB healthy. Touch acceptance failed despite registration and IRQ enable.
limitations: Candidate driver imported from GPL community source with inherited warnings
Initial rails-retained experiment may fail; then inspect supplies with fresh calibration backups before PMIC work
Touch success does not prove suspend/wake, rotation, mobile data or charging
Warm-reload state confounds transport comparisons; candidate4 clock not verified. Static assertions and compilation are not electrical unit tests.
exit_gate: No supported-touch claim without physical events and visible UI operation; stop on oops, USB loss, reset/IRQ errors or unstable input. Restore saved vendor_boot through Fastboot.
